en: A sepia-toned, vintage postcard showing a street scene with a prominent building featuring ornate arched windows and a domed tower topped with a cross. The building is surrounded by an ornate iron fence. There are several people and a cart visible on the street. The text on the postcard is in German and mentions 'Ragusa' and 'Griechisch-orientalische Kirche,' indicating the building is a Greek Orthodox church.
